changes: Cooperative cancel.request -> Canceled=true, Success=false, Bundle=null, exit3; checkpoints between files and1MiB blocks.
Failed and canceled attempts remove only their owned temporary/published artifacts. Cleanup refusal is surfaced in bounded Warnings.
Destination archive errors abort the job instead of being mislabeled as skipped source files.
Redaction now covers JSON-escaped selected paths, Windows profile names with spaces, and raw/quoted auth headers.
Ordinal relative path ordering fixes nondeterministic file/chunk numbering; session identifiers and timestamps remain unique.
Worker checks ZIP central-directory readability and required manifest entry after writing; no full rehash claim.
